palette.notes: Measured palette_size 1 is a measurement miss (soft gradients, bloom and glow; ramps 0, dither 0.0008), so no count. Hot orange-pink sunset light, shadows go to violet-purple on the floor and desk legs.

lighting: One strong low sun from the window behind her: rim light and lens-flare streaks on hair and shoulders, long violet cast shadows of chair and desk across the floor. Backlit, high-key window vs darker figure.
silhouette: Girl seated side-on at a school desk: long twin-tail hair hanging past the chair is the read; red shoes and the orange chair frame give accent shapes. Large figure, filling the lower half of a vertical frame.

motion.timing: Wallpaper loop. Code: 31 changes in 20 s, about 1.55 drawings/s, hold median 66.7 ms (p75 187.5 ms), on 2s. The pose barely changes across 12 sheet frames: tiny head/hair sway, light shimmer, flare streaks.

texture: Painterly pixel art with heavy post: bloom, blurred bokeh clouds in the window, glow and flare overlays on top of the sprite. Pixel edges are softened by the effects and by TikTok compression.
camera: Locked-off side view, no camera move. Character placed off-centre with window light filling the top.

acting.enters: Does not enter; on screen from the first frame (a looping wallpaper).
acting.acts: Barely acts: sits, small head and hair sway, occasional blink-like change. The scene's light does the work, not the character.
acting.depth: Single plane: figure and desk in the foreground, window and sky as the far background; no use of a small background character.

techniques: backlit sunset with rim light on the hero
long cast shadows pushed to violet (warm light, cool shadow)
bloom and lens-flare streak overlays on pixel art
near-static loop: ambient light motion carries the clip
out-of-focus background (bokeh clouds) to separate planes
feel: warm backlight + violet shadows + almost-still girl + glow overlays = calm lo-fi wallpaper mood
for_fred: Use this for a held 'breather' beat, not an action beat: put Fred still in warm backlight with a rim light and a long cool shadow, and let only the light and a 2-frame fin/hair-like sway move. Avoid making a whole reel this static; one 1-2 s hold like this before Fred re-enters reads as a pause.
